candidates.name: JavaScript DataView.setInt32 over WebAssembly.Memory.buffer
candidates.proposed_use: Prepare a native 32-bit integer at the selected module-memory byte offset using a little-endian DataView write, before invoking an already available export.

citations.section: Method contract L182; Syntax and Parameters L203–225; Exceptions L230–235
Memory description L172–178; buffer and growth L196–207; Examples L221–246

candidates.opened_evidence: setInt32 stores a signed 32-bit value at a byte offset with an explicit endian flag. Memory.buffer exposes the module memory; an example writes through a DataView then calls a Wasm export using those bytes.
candidates.remaining_adapter: Obtain the module memory/export and valid Go ABI stack offset, set littleEndian=true, refresh the view if memory growth detaches its buffer, and invoke the chosen function. Go marking/linking and argument ABI remain integration work.
candidates.limitations: DataView.setInt32 is explicitly named in the initial text and is not a novel component. No Go js/wasm build or runtime execution was tested. The delivered Go compiler excerpt does not include wasmexport; whole direct-export behavior is not established.
